subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate password toggle functionality across all platforms to let users see password in clear text

question: Should credential reveal state be ephemeral and masked-by-default per field, or may OpenClaw persist visibility preferences across sessions and platforms?
rationale: The UX request is valid, but the proposed persisted clear-text preference changes credential exposure behavior on shared, streamed, or recorded devices and needs maintainer security/product intent.

options.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
options.body: Implement per-field reveal controls that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility across sessions.

options.title: Persist Visibility Preference
options.body: Allow local persistence only after maintainers explicitly accept the exposure tradeoff and define reset behavior.

options.title: Defer Broad Rollout
options.body: Keep the existing partial web behavior until a full credential-field inventory and platform owner plan are agreed.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
recommendation.body: Implement per-field reveal controls that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility across sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: He already reviewed this issue and has the strongest current routing signal across the affected web and macOS surfaces.
